The memory usage threshold for the side bucket catalog of a time series collection. The default is 100 MB. If this threshold is exceeded, idle buckets are expired.

statements.note: IDL default 104857600 (commented 100 MB); Alibaba table also 104857600.

statements.statement: IDL and Alibaba docs describe it as the threshold above which idle side-catalog buckets expire, not a strict total-memory ceiling.
statements.note: Both describe an idle-bucket expiry threshold; neither states a hard ceiling.

edits.rationale: The upstream IDL sets default 104857600 (100 MB) and describes the value as the threshold above which idle buckets are expired. The Alibaba/ApsaraDB MongoDB 8.0 table gives the same default and the same expiry-threshold description. Neither describes a hard total-memory ceiling.
